correctness.rationale: Independent distinct-prefix counting gives each exact joint event; strict Newton elementary-symmetric inequalities prove every pairwise cross-product for m>=2 and positive masses, including boundaries and ties. The actual embedded standalone script independently enumerated all events and passed 2,235 exact rational assertions across 25 vectors; those tests are not an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The accepted added result is strict conditional likelihood-ratio ordering of the first repeated label by the first collision time, its monotone-transform covariance consequence, and the iff-uniform independence criterion. The exact joint formula derives from Camarri–Pitman and is not itself claimed original. Accessible primary full text and relevant published comparisons found no equivalent or stronger covering implication; known access risks remain.
residual_risks: A first-repeat collision-label MLR theorem may occur implicitly in uninspected older renewal/occupancy papers, despite searches and close-source comparisons.
Holst (1995) full text could not be inspected; only its abstract was available.
Camarri–Pitman equation (13) already gives the joint event when the repeated element is marked; the novelty claim intentionally excludes that trivial enumeration.
Generalization to countably infinite supports, dependent draws and higher multiplicity thresholds is not established.

value.rationale: An exact global all-parameter MLR order in two basic observables of heterogeneous birthday sampling is structural and much stronger than a special-case moment calculation. It orders every conditional increasing statistic of repeat-type popularity and characterizes uniform laws through dependence. The early quadratic/late linear size-bias endpoints make the precise invariant and its future use in collision sampling natural.
